_extended_2026_09_18: Extended with the version inventory, compatibility matrix and temporal reproducibility determination. NOT a new register: the release architecture is the right home for version state, and creating a separate compatibility document would have produced a second source of truth for the same propositions. Deployment mechanics above are unchanged.

version_inventory._rule: Every entry names its SOURCE OF TRUTH IN CODE. A version that exists only here is not controlled; it is asserted. check_version_inventory_matches_source reads each value from the file named below.

caller_supplied_gap.finding: jrs_version and codebook_version are REQUIRED ARGUMENTS to buildManifest and are validated only for PRESENCE. lib/manifest/build.js throws if either is absent and accepts any string if present.
caller_supplied_gap.consequence: A manifest can assert a JRS or Codebook version that never existed, and two manifests for the same evaluation can disagree, with nothing failing. The manifest is the artifact a customer holds as their durable evidence, so an unvalidated version field is an unverifiable provenance claim on the one record the customer keeps.
caller_supplied_gap.status: OPEN - X-9. Closed at the GUARD level today; the build-time validation is a code change to a deployable path and is queued rather than bundled into the current deployment candidate.
caller_supplied_gap.not_established: Whether any manifest has ever carried a wrong version. Zero production manifests exist, so the exposure is latent.

compatibility_matrix._rule: COMPATIBILITY REQUIRES EVIDENCE. Sequential version numbers are not evidence. Every cell is one of COMPATIBLE, INCOMPATIBLE, MIGRATION_REQUIRED, DEPRECATED, UNSUPPORTED, NOT_ESTABLISHED. NOT_ESTABLISHED is the honest default and is used wherever no second version has ever existed to test against.

jrs_standard.why: single version; no pair exists to test

model.why: single pinned model. Retirement date NOT PUBLISHED BY THE PROVIDER IN ANY RECORD HELD HERE, and is not invented.

published_contract.why: TWO PUBLISHED CONTRACTS DESCRIBE THE SAME PATH /api/v1/review-engine AT DIFFERENT VERSIONS. Recorded in the Master Register as two conflicting OpenAPI documents. Neither may be edited: openapi.json is frozen under B-016 pending counsel.

_determination_definitions.PASS: Every MATERIAL element of the evaluation configuration is identifiable from the artifact and its controlled sources.
_determination_definitions.CONDITIONAL: Every material element is identifiable; one or more NON-MATERIAL elements cannot currently be reproduced or independently verified.
_determination_definitions.FAIL: A material element cannot be identified or reconstructed from the available record.

temporal_reproducibility._materiality: MATERIAL means an element whose value changes the INTERPRETATION of the result: the condition vocabulary, the routing vocabulary, the five statuses, the engine version, the model identifier, the Codebook version and the input identity. NON-MATERIAL means an element that affects re-execution but not interpretation: runtime, host, wall-clock timing, and dependency versions that carry no semantics. A missing non-material element must NOT produce an automatic FAIL.

not_carried.prompt_or_instruction_version: NOT ESTABLISHED. The engine prompt is not versioned, so two evaluations under the same engine version may have used different instructions with nothing recording it. MATERIAL.
not_carried.source_commit: NOT CARRIED. The manifest identifies the engine version but not the commit that built it. NON-MATERIAL for interpretation, MATERIAL for re-execution.
not_carried.dependency_versions: NOT APPLICABLE. No package.json or lockfile exists, deliberately.
not_carried.runtime: NOT CARRIED. Vercel Edge. NON-MATERIAL for interpretation.

temporal_reproducibility.why_conditional_and_not_pass: The prompt/instruction version is MATERIAL by the definition above -- it changes interpretation -- and it is not versioned. That alone prevents PASS. It is recorded as X-10 rather than resolved by asserting a version that does not exist.
temporal_reproducibility.why_conditional_and_not_fail: Every other material element IS identifiable, and the input hash lets a holder of the original prove correspondence. The record is RECONSTRUCTABLE even where it is not RE-EXECUTABLE.

_four_distinct_properties.reconstructable: YES for the elements listed above.
_four_distinct_properties.reproducible: NOT ESTABLISHED. The engine is LLM-backed; run-to-run agreement is measured, not assumed.
_four_distinct_properties.re_executable: NO. The route is closed in production and no historical evaluation exists to rerun.
_four_distinct_properties.verified_re_execution: NO. Zero evaluations have been rerun and compared. Never claim otherwise.
